mapper.select:
-- Select matching cases for paginated operation screens. SELECT mc.id AS matching_case_id, mc.announcement_id, mc.member_user_id, mc.verification_id, mc.status_code, mc.blocked_reason_code, mc.matched_at, mc.reviewed_by, mc.reviewed_at, mc.created_at, mc.updated_at FROM matching_cases mc
ORDER BY mc.created_at DESC, mc.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count matching cases for paginated list. SELECT count(1) FROM matching_cases mc

-- Select matching case details by primary key. SELECT mc.id AS matching_case_id, mc.announcement_id, mc.member_user_id, mc.verification_id, mc.status_code, mc.blocked_reason_code, mc.matched_at, mc.reviewed_by, mc.reviewed_at, mc.created_at, mc.updated_at FROM matching_cases mc WHERE mc.id = #{matchingCaseId}

-- Select matching case by business unique key to avoid duplicate creation. SELECT mc.id AS matching_case_id, mc.announcement_id, mc.member_user_id, mc.verification_id, mc.status_code, mc.blocked_reason_code, mc.matched_at, mc.reviewed_by, mc.reviewed_at, mc.created_at, mc.updated_at FROM matching_cases mc WHERE mc.announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND mc.member_user_id = #{memberUserId} AND mc.verification_id = #{verificationId}

-- Select condition-level matching result details. SELECT mrd.id AS matching_result_detail_id, mrd.matching_case_id, mrd.condition_scope_code, mrd.condition_key, mrd.result_code, mrd.basis_value, mrd.required_value, mrd.reason, mrd.created_at FROM matching_result_details mrd WHERE mrd.matching_case_id = #{matchingCaseId} ORDER BY mrd.condition_scope_code ASC, mrd.condition_key ASC
-- Select announcement status fields needed before matching creation. SELECT a.id AS announcement_id, a.manual_status_code, a.approval_status_code FROM announcements a WHERE a.id = #{announcementId}

-- Select verification status fields needed before matching creation. SELECT pv.id AS verification_id, pv.member_user_id, pv.status_code, pv.is_current, pv.is_matching_blocked FROM partner_verifications pv WHERE pv.id = #{verificationId}

-- Select checked restriction flags used for MVP status classification. SELECT vrf.restriction_code FROM verification_restriction_flags vrf WHERE vrf.verification_id = #{verificationId} AND vrf.is_checked = true ORDER BY vrf.restriction_code ASC
mapper.insert: -- Insert matching case with only status and restriction reason fields. INSERT INTO matching_cases ( id, announcement_id, member_user_id, verification_id, status_code, blocked_reason_code, matched_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{matchingCaseId}, #{announcementId}, #{memberUserId}, #{verificationId}, #{statusCode}, #{blockedReasonCode}, now(), #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )

-- Insert MVP matching result detail with only PASS, FAIL, SKIPPED, or REVIEW_REQUIRED. INSERT INTO matching_result_details ( id, matching_case_id, condition_scope_code, condition_key, result_code, basis_value, required_value, reason, created_by ) VALUES ( #{matchingResultDetailId}, #{matchingCaseId}, #{conditionScopeCode}, #{conditionKey}, #{resultCode}, #{basisValue}, #{requiredValue}, #{reason}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update matching case status manually without creating application progress. UPDATE matching_cases SET status_code = #{statusCode}, blocked_reason_code = #{blockedReasonCode}, reviewed_by = #{actorUserId}, reviewed_at = now(), updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{matchingCaseId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert non-PII matching operation audit log. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
